retain: Positive entity gain, zero lost correct mentions, zero regressed samples; otherwise reject
inference_inputs: PCM and predeclared specialty only; no reference or gold entities
bounded_copy_development: Designed after reviewing the initial 48-recording pilot; new holdout recordings excluded from that pilot
bounded_copy_inputs: Existing raw and scene-primed ASR on identical PCM plus declared glossary/anchors; no gold transcript
mention_counting: Longest non-overlapping canonical occurrences; repeated gold names scored by ordinal
filter_freeze: Both extraction filters frozen before reading or scoring this new holdout; raw/scene_prompt decoding underway independently
restricted_copy: Chinese target >=4 chars, same first character and final two characters, no Chinese-to-ASCII copy; same base hard checks
pilot_safety_failure: Broad gate replaces valid 曾经系统学习 with 神经系统学习; restricted gate must abstain
